evidence.note: findMinimalFold writes exhausted with noMatch (ambiguous false), or ambiguous with exhausted false and match none, or both flags false. It never writes ambiguous and exhausted together.
mergeMinimalFoldStartMatches returns ambiguous true only with exhausted false, and otherwise copies startSearch.exhausted with ambiguous false.

notes: Seed member match is Option<MatchedText>, not a boolean, so it drops out of the member list. UniqueMatchSearch alone has only ambiguous. MinimalFoldMatchSearch is the two-boolean owner. Present match occurs only when both flags are false; ambiguous and exhausted each force match none. Combined-true is unwritten.
